excluded_headers.SDL_oldnames.h: SDL2 compatibility aliases, not SDL3 API
excluded_headers.SDL_main_impl.h: Host entry-point implementation, not script exports

excluded_header_prefixes.SDL_opengl: Bundled graphics API headers, not SDL functions
excluded_header_prefixes.SDL_egl: Bundled EGL API headers, not SDL functions

SDL_Wav.reason: Project-owned WAV buffer wrapper; not a declaration in SDL headers

function:SDL_CreateTexture.reason: Only RGBA32 streaming and target textures; no general format/access binding

function:SDL_LockTexture.reason: Whole-image synchronous upload from a checked RGBA8 array; no borrowed mapping exposed

function:SDL_UnlockTexture.reason: Native cleanup within synchronous RGBA upload; no script unlock API

function:SDL_RenderReadPixels.reason: Current viewport only; returned surface owned by with_read_pixels

function:SDL_ConvertSurface.reason: RGBA32 copy only; temporary conversion surface stays native

function:SDL_LockSurface.reason: Internal lock of converted readback surface; no borrowed pixels exposed

function:SDL_UnlockSurface.reason: Internal cleanup of converted readback surface
